Tools.Door: Doors (click a wall to add a door, click a door to edit it)
Tools.Edit: Edit points (drag to move, Shift-drag a road or river point to set its width, right-click to delete)
Tools.Stamp: Stamps (click the canvas to place the selected stamp)
Tools.Materials: Room materials (click a room to set its floor and walls)

Levels.Title: Levels
Levels.Name: Level name
Levels.Empty: This scene has no levels yet. Everything drawn shows on every level until you add one.
Levels.RemoveBlocked: Remove or move this level's features before removing it.

Submap.Title: Interior
Submap.NotLinked: This building does not lead anywhere yet.
Submap.NoScenes: There are no other scenes to link.

TextureSet.Name: Terrain texture set
TextureSet.Hint: Which asset-pack texture set fills biome regions, brush strokes, room floors and roads. Terrain without a texture in the set uses a flat colour.

StampSnap.Name: Snap placed stamps to the grid
StampSnap.Hint: Snap a placed stamp's top-left corner to the nearest grid intersection.

TerrainRegions.Name: Terrain as Scene Regions
TerrainRegions.Hint: Mirror each painted biome area and brush stroke as a Scene Region named after its biome, so region behaviours (difficult terrain, weather and so on) can be attached to it.

StampScale.Name: Stamp scale
StampScale.Hint: Multiplier over a stamp's authored grid footprint when it is placed (1 = authored size).

Browser.Title: Stamps
Browser.NoSelection: Select a stamp to see its variants.
Browser.CardHint: Click to select for placing, double-click to place at the view centre, or drag onto the canvas.
